comment: A joined fighter walks unarmed into the other side's route under Licence to Kill, falls, and watches living teammates. Both routes were checked with a straight-line walker from every spawn. Run with FRAGR_QA_MODE=sabotage FRAGR_QA_MUTATORS=licence-to-kill FRAGR_QA_MAP=4 FRAGR_QA_BOTS=7 FRAGR_QA_SEED=42.

states.name: sabotage_fallen_join
states.note: Join; the next round may be needed if muster has passed.

states.name: sabotage_fallen_watch
states.note: Fallen in the open: the view follows a living teammate, and the pips show who is left.
